nodes.text: The two girls prepare the room, grabbing snacks, copying answer sheets, and sharpening pencils.
Working together, they prepare the testing area...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Copies done! I'm passing them over!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Sharpened pencils, coming through!
And in a few short minutes, the library is ready for testing! In a neat pile on everyone's desk is an answer sheet, a test booklet, a sharpened pencil, a water bottle, and a granola bar.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know how to make everything look so neat.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I really want tonight to be perfect, so you don't have to stress out at the actual test.
$ZOE walks back to the test-takers. Sam is chewing on her pencil thoughtfully as she considers a problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The nerds aren't distracting her at all!
The drill has finally been put away.
The nerds go back to their game-playing, and while several shouts come from their direction, for the most part, their playing is more subdued.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That'll work for now...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Wow, I just thought of a game that I'd like to call 'nerd charades'.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Have you never played a strategic co-op before? We can't communicate like that that!
Dex throws up his hands.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I got it. It's an explosive!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No! That's my way of saying 'no deal'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, we'll turn the volume down and try to stay quiet. Will that work?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's not the gameplay experience you wanted, but I can get the Robotics Club a free lunch for your victory.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Deal. I'll take a free lunch any day.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then it's settled.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. Free is delicious!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You set a low bar, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But fine. As long as we get to pick the lunch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So let me get this straight. You want us to turn the sound off and `act out` our taunts and commands?
nodes.text_bbcode: So let me get this straight. You want us to turn the sound off and [color=#e23b3b][i]act out[/i][/color] our taunts and commands?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So let me get this straight... You want us to turn the sound off and talk to one another by typing it out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that such a silly request?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, that's not exactly ideal...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Mouth the words? Sign language? I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There are other ways of communicating. You can always...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, we did bring our headsets. It'd be pretty much the same as playing at home.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, that only solves half the problem. Even if we use headphones, it's a strategy game. We need to talk to each other.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: If we turn the sound off, then we won't be able to hear any music cues or the sounds of victory music as my team beats Kevin's! What's the point?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And even if we do turn the sound off, that's only half of it. We need to talk to one another. It's a cooperative strategy game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Turn the sound off?
$ZOE heads back to the test side of the room...
And spots Hector and Amanda making out at one of the tables. She stands behind them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Time's up, guys. Pencils down. Lips `off.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Time's up, guys. Pencils down. Lips [color=#3b78e2][i]off.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means `you,` Hector...
nodes.text_bbcode: That means [color=#3b78e2][i]you,[/i][/color] Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yeah!
He moves away from Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, this is just how we study, $ZOE. Makeout breaks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I do need to learn how to treat lacerations and wounds... That should be pretty quiet, right?
He takes out a first aid kit and a dummy person. He whispers to it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't worry, dummy man! I'll save you!
And begins bandaging the fake man's arm.
`Quietly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Quietly.[/b]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good choice, me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Woo boy! I'm excited to try that one!
No sooner has $ZOE turned her back when she suddenly hears a buzzing sound!
`ZZzt!!! ZZZZzzt! Zzt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]ZZzt!!! ZZZZzzt! Zzt![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What on earth?
Erik has taken out a small bit drill and is using it to make designs in a big plank of wood.
`ZZzt!!! ZZZZzzt! ZZzzt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]ZZzt!!! ZZZZzzt! ZZzzt![/b]

nodes.text: With the combination of both the fire alarm and the drill, the test-takers have paused in their test-taking to look around.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What is going on?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And now it sounds like psychotic woodpeckers...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is with you and birds today?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's what the reading assignment in my test booklet is all about!
$ZOE stands next to Erik and clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you said you were `carving` wood, not cutting it...
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you said you were [color=#3b78e2][i]carving[/i][/color] wood, not cutting it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Technically, I'm `routing!` This is something I do to create designs in the wood.
nodes.text_bbcode: Technically, I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]routing![/i][/color] This is something I do to create designs in the wood.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can't you... Not do it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm no Da Vinci, $ZOE. I don't have the artistic vision to do this another way.
$ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe you can just limit how much you're using the drill?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure thing, $ZOE!
$ZOE and Sam start preparing the room, but $ZOE is distracted!
She messes up the copies and oversharpens the pencils!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you even doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, Sam... I just got caught up thinking about how much I wanted this to be perfect... And then this happened.
$ZOE holds up a torn up answer sheet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to print out more answer sheets.
After a long while...
$ZOE reprints the answer sheets, gets new pencils, and starts setting everything out correctly. Then she sits down and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, what's the big deal? It's just a practice test. We could literally write our answers on scrap paper. No one's watching.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wanted this to be perfect. I wanted it to be like the real thing, so you'd feel comfortable during the actual test...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You are way too nice for your own good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can do this, Sam. I'm going to do everything in my power to make sure the S.E.T. goes well for you. Then you're going to use that scholarship money to go to an awesome school!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, Twin Branches Online University of Fools.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not a school, and you know it! Come on, you can't think like that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The S.E.T. is coming up soon! And I'm not getting any smarter.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but you `are` getting more prepared! That's what's tonight's all about! The more you practice, the more you'll be conditioned to do well on the test!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] getting more prepared! That's what's tonight's all about! The more you practice, the more you'll be conditioned to do well on the test!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When you put it like that, I suppose a practice test isn't much different from practicing for swimming... And I `know` how effective twenty laps in the pool can be.
nodes.text_bbcode: When you put it like that, I suppose a practice test isn't much different from practicing for swimming... And I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] how effective twenty laps in the pool can be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess this means I can actually help you set up now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to freak Sam out, but she's kind of right. She `has` to get the practice in, or else she won't get accepted to a good school!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't want to freak Sam out, but she's kind of right. She [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] to get the practice in, or else she won't get accepted to a good school!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE? So? Do you need help?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, er... That's exactly what I need! I have a bunch of snacks to unpack, answer sheets to copy, and pencils to sharpen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I am? Really? There are more A's `in` 'report card' than there are on my actual report card.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am? Really? There are more A's [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] 'report card' than there are on my actual report card.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I didn't mean--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Forget it, $ZOE. I'm going to do awful on these S.E.T.s. I've got the lowest grade in English class, and I'm barely getting by in Geometry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, that doesn't make you `not smart.` You know more than you think.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, that doesn't make you [color=#3b78e2][i]not smart.[/i][/color] You know more than you think.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. I `know` things. Don't microwave aluminum foil. Don't run with scissors.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, sure. I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] things. Don't microwave aluminum foil. Don't run with scissors.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have common sense. But I'm not `school` smart.
nodes.text_bbcode: I have common sense. But I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]school[/i][/color] smart.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there a difference?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. The difference is that people who are `school` smart don't get intimidated by standardized tests. The S.E.T. freaks me out.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes. The difference is that people who are [color=#3b78e2][i]school[/i][/color] smart don't get intimidated by standardized tests. The S.E.T. freaks me out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why does this `one` test determine where you go to college?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why does this [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] test determine where you go to college?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, but that test freaks everyone out. And that's why we're practicing tonight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said it yourself. You're actually studying with Nick. You're going through all the questions, you're reviewing, and you're doing practice tests.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the most important thing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? It's not having a ginormous smart brain?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Contrary to popular belief, being intelligent isn't all about having a 'smart brain'. It's also about effort.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you've been pouring yourself into studying ever since you won the Shakespeare scholarship.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that's good to know. I feel better.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks, man!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No problem. Emily and I will be just around the corner with the distraction.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right! Everyone, to your places!
The students scatters, and Owen walks along the back wall of the school and waits for his signal...
Five minutes later, he sees the lights of Monarch Prep go out!
Owen scales the wall, climbs over, and lands squarely in the center of a stone path. He makes his way to the main building, careful not to step on the grass so as not to trigger the alarm.
Just as Owen closes in on the school, he runs into Brock!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: You. Boy. Stop!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Ah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen turns and runs, pumping his legs as fast as he can! When he's put some space between him and Brock...
Owen grabs the perfume from his pocket, opens the vial, and flings it at Brock!
The smell of rotten eggs, foul body odor, and decaying fish punches through the air. The scent is enough to stop Brock in his tracks.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Smell. Bad.
Owen keeps sprinting even as he coughs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh man! That is `rank!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh man! That is [color=#e23b3b][i]rank![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Owen grabs the itching powder from his pocket, opens the top of the bag, and flings it at Brock!
It hits the gentle giant square in the chest! Immediately, Brock stops in his tracks, rubbing his arms and torso like he's doing a weird dance!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Itch. Scratch!
Owen keeps sprinting even as he laughs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad that's not on me...
Owen grabs the smoke-sploder from his pocket and flings it at Brock's feet!
Plumes of smoke in different colors poof out from the exploder, engulfing Brock in a rainbow haze!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Can't. See.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Too. Many. Colors.
Owen keeps sprinting even as he admires Ben's handiwork.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's awesome. I'd like to see `that` at a party...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's awesome. I'd like to see [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] at a party...

nodes.text: With Brock indisposed, Owen runs around the corner, dashes up the stairs to Monarch Prep's back door, and...
...Sees Paige waiting calmly on the steps.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige! You're outside! But what about--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whitford?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You won't have to worry about her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure, but we should probably run. Brock's right behind me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't worry. Brock's a total sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He is? But he chased me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. I told him to go get you. Oh, here he is now.
Brock walks up to them, his nose crinkled in disgust. As he nears, Paige draws away from him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Brock, you smell! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, that's kind of my fault. It'll wear off when you shower...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe you should do that `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, maybe you should do that [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Go. Shower.
As Brock goes to shower, $ZOE, Emily, Kimi, and Ben run up to them.
Brocks walks up to them, rubbing his elbows and knees furiously.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Brock, what's wrong? Why are you dancing so funny?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, that's kind of my fault. The itching powder will wear off in a couple minutes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, maybe you should try to walk it off or something.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Go. Walk.
As Brock walks away, $ZOE, Emily, Kimi, and Ben run up to them.
Brock walks up to them, rubbing his eye.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Brock, where have you been?

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Boy. Throw. Cloud.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Think. Pretty.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It was, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oookay. Never mind. Can you just take care of him?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa, wait, what does that mean?
Brock turns to Owen and holds out a large meaty hand.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Take. Coat?
Brock helps Owen out of his hoodie... Just as $ZOE, Emily, Kimi, and Ben run up to them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owen! There you are! I was waiting for your signal...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, what happened to the plan?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: New plan. You don't have to break into Monarch Prep anymore.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aw, man...
Ben sadly tosses a bottle of blue liquid a few yards away. A suspicious nebula of blue gas blooms safely away from the group.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, really! I'd just gotten the `distraction` under control...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, really! I'd just gotten the [color=#3b78e2][i]distraction[/i][/color] under control...

nodes.text: Emily yanks one of the strings on her coat. Several beautiful, white doves fly out and into the night sky.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Keeping those under wraps was `hard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Keeping those under wraps was [color=#3b78e2][i]hard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What were those for?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A surprise. And it was going to be spectacular... Emphasis on the `was.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A surprise. And it was going to be spectacular... Emphasis on the [color=#e23b3b][i]was.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to break in anymore. I'm Perfect at this school.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And no, I'm not complimenting myself. I know you were all thinking it. It's a title. Like a British boarding school `prefect`, but better.
nodes.text_bbcode: And no, I'm not complimenting myself. I know you were all thinking it. It's a title. Like a British boarding school [color=#3b78e2][i]prefect[/i][/color], but better.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway... That means I have some power around here. And with my mom and Tad currently thinking I'm their angel again, I have money too. Isn't that peachy?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's a real Cinderella story there...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And that means, I can just walk in?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Privilege has its privileges.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now do you want to hang out or what? I still have curfew.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't tell me your team wants to come in too because I don't think Whitford will let that many beggars in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And we missed you too, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're leaving now. Have fun!
Owen's team, sans Owen, heads to $ZOE's car.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was not as much fun as I was promised.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least Owen got to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I forgot how mean she is. Why are we rooting for her again?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because under that mean exterior, there's a heart of gold...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Probably literally!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, you guys. Less talking about Paige and more getting into the car. We have an S.E.T. practice test tonight, remember?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I remember. It's the only reason my mom let me in your car in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, it'll be fun.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah... Maybe. But I'm not even taking the test this year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, well, you don't have to come to the practice test if you don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, I'm actually looking forward to it. We'll all be hanging out together, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Totally.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then let's go!
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Later that afternoon, at school...
$ZOE is setting up the library tables in rows for the practice S.E.T. test when Sam wanders in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. You're back from Monarch Prep already? That was fast.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Paige has a thing set up with the principal. Owen just walked in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, that's a change.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, it was kind of weird, but I'm happy that everything worked out for them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, you do seem happy... Especially, since your run-in with Howard on that trip for the Robotics Club competition.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which we totally still need to talk about, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, I know... We will, I promise, but right now, I need to finish setting everything up for the practice S.E.T.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really glad that Taylor let me sign out the library for this. This is the perfect setting for a practice test. It's quiet and distraction free.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, that's just wonderful.
Sam stares at the floor, saying nothing, and $ZOE goes on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, uh... you're here early. No one else is coming for another half hour. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I just... Wanted to... See if you need my help...
Sam looks down and absently twirls a pencil she has in her hand.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, fine. You don't need my help. I guess I'm just anxious. Nick's been helping me study...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And yes, in case you're wondering, we do actually study... Most of the time... Sometimes... Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I don't know if I'm ready, $ZOE. And the S.E.T. that's coming up in a few weeks is the last one this year. It's my only chance to get a good score!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The scholarship I received won't mean a thing if I can't actually get into a college.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if I fail?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you won't. You're...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The smelly perfume it is!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It won't hurt him, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No way. It's not lethal. It just smells awful. But it'll wear off after a shower...
Owen tucks the vial of smelly perfume in his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The itching powder it is!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just throw it at him when he starts to chase you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It won't hurt him, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! It'll wear off after a few minutes...
Owen tucks the bag of itching powder in his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The smoke-sploder it is!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just throw it at his feet when you get the chance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It won't hurt him, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, not at all. He just won't be able to see for a couple seconds.
Owen tucks the smoke-sploder in his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, it wasn't perfect.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not always perfect the first few times.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Then put `more` effort into it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Then put [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] effort into it...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Do it again.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Not `great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#3b78e2][i]great.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It can't have been that bad...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's like you weren't even trying. Come on, it's not `that` hard.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like you weren't even trying. Come on, it's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Again!

nodes.text: $ZOE rushes through the crowds. And at last sees her opening! In one terrific leap, she clears a table and lands in front of the wastebasket.
She swings up the extinguisher, aims the nozzle at the base of the flames, and squeezes the release lever!
`Pssssshhhhhhht!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Pssssshhhhhhht![/b]

nodes.text: A white jet stream pours from the extinguisher...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There!
...But it's not enough! The flames rise, despite $ZOE's efforts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!
Erik is near her, trapped in the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE, the fire alarm! Quick!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There are way too many people in here! It's a fire hazard!
Without hesitation, $ZOE turns and jerks the fire alarm lever down, setting off a high-pitched wail that drowns out the music!
`E-e-e-e-eeeeeeeee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]E-e-e-e-eeeeeeeee![/b]

nodes.text: An instant later, water gushes down from overhead, sending all the students in the library scattering!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: My movie!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: My game!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: My hair!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, look! It's raining!
$ZOE watches as all the students flood out of the library... All except Sam. At long last, Sam rises from her desk, leaving her waterlogged test paper behind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... `Sam!` I ruined everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no... [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color] I ruined everything!

nodes.text: The next day, in Principal McCormick's office...

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: $ZOE, I understand that you didn't invite these people into the library, but you did sign the sheet accepting responsibility for any damage.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: And there was a `lot` of damage.
nodes.text_bbcode: And there was a [color=#3b78e2][i]lot[/i][/color] of damage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Principal McCormick, that's not fair, is it? I only planned the S.E.T. portion of the evening!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Andrew and his flash mob?

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: Andrew is paying his own dues, believe me. He'll be scrubbing scuff marks off desks from now until graduation.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: But as for the library, you're still accountable. I suppose you can consider it one of the 'perks' of being elected to Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Principal McCormick
nodes.text: This will go on your permanent record, but only as an unfortunate accident. And I hope I can trust you to take care of the cleaning of the library as well?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am... At the end of the school day.
$ZOE leaves the office, dejected.
$ZOE is at her locker when Sam finds her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It... Could have been better. The 'incident' is going on my permanent record.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it wasn't really your fault!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It might as well be... Maybe not the fire, but I wanted to give you the best S.E.T. test prep ever, and I let you down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that what you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, yeah... Isn't that what happened?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, I finished the practice test.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did? ...Despite everything?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, despite everything. And after that, I'm pretty sure you could put a cannon next to my ear during the real thing, and I wouldn't even flinch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. How'd you do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Better than expected! I have more studying to do though.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd be happy to help you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm counting on it. And, you know, next time, could you `not` bring the flash mob?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm counting on it. And, you know, next time, could you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] bring the flash mob?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... Sure.

nodes.text: The book bounces off the glass and hits $ZOE so hard in the face that she falls backwards to the floor in a crowd of dancers!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess if you can't beat 'em...
She starts dancing to the music, moving very slowly towards the fire.
But she doesn't know any of the moves! When the dance has everyone rush forward, $ZOE trips and falls to the floor!
$ZOE angrily pushes people out of the way, a fierce glare on her face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Move it!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Angry $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Move it unless you want to get hit!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ack!
She uses the fire extinguisher as a battering ram to clear her path. People dive out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Social Chair coming through!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Get out of the way!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Get out of the way![/i][/color]

$ZOE grabs ahold of the ladder and pushes off! It slides along the track, bypassing everyone in the center of the room!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah!
She jumps off just as she's close enough to the flaming wastebasket...
And that's when a couple students jump in her way, dancing to the music as they climb on the tables...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is getting way out of hand!
$ZOE can't see a good way around the crowd! She fumbles her way through, reaches her hands out, and...

options.label: Pushes people out of her way!

nodes.text: She leaps onto the book cart!
Her momentum carries the cart forward fast! She rolls very quickly into the thick of the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! People are in the way!
...And strikes a group of dancers, knocking them over. The other students around them angrily push the cart and tip it over!
$ZOE is knocked to the floor in a crowd of dancers!
$ZOE can't decide!
The dancers shove her towards the center of the room, and she decides to try for the book cart!
$ZOE tries the door once more. This time, the door budges and opens!
She grabs the extinguisher and glances around for a good way to get to the fire! Dancers, film club, test-takers, and nerds all block her way.
She spots a rolling ladder attached to a bookshelf and a loaded book cart in the center of the room.
She jumps onto the...

nodes.text: $ZOE goes with instinct and throws a book at the glass, hoping to shatter it!
Owen glances around the gardens, falling silent.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Everything here is so nice... It's weird that this is the world she lives in...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Owen... Your mouth's hanging open again.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It is not.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then what are you thinking about? You know, other than how fabulously rich I am.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually, that's exactly what I was thinking about.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here I thought I was going to be a hero and try to break you out...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But now that I'm here... `I` don't even want to leave.
nodes.text_bbcode: But now that I'm here... [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] don't even want to leave.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that's just too bad... Because you're going to have to go. Whitford's going to issue curfew soon, and you need to be out of here before then.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I thought you were the 'prefect' or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Perfect.` And while I have a lot of power, I don't want Whitford finding you and reporting it to my parents.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect.[/i][/color] And while I have a lot of power, I don't want Whitford finding you and reporting it to my parents.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll get out of here, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, don't get all lame on me. We'll see each other again. You can visit now, remember?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah...
She leans over and kisses him sweetly.
Back in the library...
$ZOE watches in horror at what's happening!
As loud music blasts over the school speakers, a huge mob of students floods the library, filling the aisles, knocking over books, and clambering up onto the tables.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: This is the best!
$ZOE is knocked back and forth by the crowd and struggles to stay near the door to see what's going on.
Following everyone in is Andrew, carrying a video camera and barking orders.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Places, everyone! Two minutes and counting!
All at once, everyone around the room begins to assemble themselves into a complicated arrangement!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What `is` this?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] this?!

nodes.text: $ZOE spots Nicole pulling Maria into the thick of the crowd. Behind her, Amanda and Hector jostle through to join in!
She grabs Hector's arm.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hector, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Flash mob. Didn't you know? We're practicing tonight for the assembly on graduation day, and it's going to be...
He trails off when he sees the look on $ZOE's face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I `knew` that a flash mob was going to be here...
nodes.text_bbcode: If I [color=#3b78e2][i]knew[/i][/color] that a flash mob was going to be here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Then `why` would I `plan` an S.E.T. practice test in the library `tonight?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Then [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] would I [color=#3b78e2][i]plan[/i][/color] an S.E.T. practice test in the library [color=#3b78e2][i]tonight?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, bad timing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go back to the test, Hector. Because I'm shutting this down.
$ZOE runs into the crowd to confront Andrew when she catches a whiff of smoke...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh great!
Small tendrils of smoke rise from the wastebasket in Erik's corner where the kindling has burst into flame!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Agh! Fire Safety Tip No. 45: Stop, drop, and roll!
Erik drops and rolls around on the carpet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, Erik, get up!
$ZOE runs to get to Erik, but in front of her, Brendan and Dex shove each other into their table of snacks.
Soda cans roll and drop to the floor. One of them pops open, spraying everyone in the vicinity in a fountain of green syrup!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ewww!
$ZOE turns to see Sam shielding her face from the soda spray.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, what are you doing? The test--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE... Do you really think I was going to be able to focus with all of `this` going on?
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, $ZOE... Do you really think I was going to be able to focus with all of [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] going on?

nodes.text: $ZOE hears the shouts of Dex as he and Brendan fight, the sound of Erik rolling on the floor, and the general rumble of the small crowd.
And just when things couldn't get any worse, Andrew lifts his video camera and pans across the room. He yells out!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It's go time! `Action!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's go time! [color=#e23b3b][i]Action![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everywhere, students start moving in perfect sync to the beat of the loud music, dancing in complicated arrays and patterns throughout the library.
They seem oblivious to the fighting of the nerds around them and to the wastebasket fire which has built itself into a small conflagration.
Erik tries to hit the switch to the fire alarm, but he gets jostled away by performers!
And $ZOE knows she has to do something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE, you--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I wanted was a nice, `quiet` S.E.T. test for you! And it hasn't happened!
nodes.text_bbcode: All I wanted was a nice, [color=#3b78e2][i]quiet[/i][/color] S.E.T. test for you! And it hasn't happened!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't have to be so upset... It's just a t--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't even say it, Sam. Now I've `had` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't even say it, Sam. Now I've [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the `library!` Have some respect!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is the [color=#3b78e2][i]library![/i][/color] Have some respect!

nodes.text: $ZOE rushes over to where a fire extinguisher is encased in glass. She tries to open the case, but it's jammed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Arg!

options.label: Throw a book at the glass!

nodes.text: He reaches for the biggest blossom on the rose bush, but it's just out of his reach! He jumps for it and misses, landing in a pile of thorns!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's going on? Can I look now?
Owen grabs for a branch to pull himself up but catches his hand on a thorn!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, ow, no!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm looking, and you can't stop me.
She uncovers one of her eyes, looks over at him, and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You really can't get anything right, can you?
She helps him up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, forgive me for trying to do something nice for you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You were trying to get a rose for me, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A rose for a rose.
Paige rolls her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's about the most cliche thing I've ever heard of.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want you to just be yourself. As poor as that is.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.
She laughs.
He reaches down near the patch of weeds, fumbling around for daisies.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: These are really hard to pluck out of the ground!
He grabs the stem of one and yanks, hard! It snaps off, sending him backwards.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's going on? Can I look now?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Hold on a second.
He manages to pluck a few more daisies, bunching them together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm looking, and you can't stop me!
She uncovers one of her eyes and sees him foraging in the weeds. She laughs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's so like you...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What is? The fact that I'm so thoughtful I'm giving you flowers?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, the fact that you're poking around in the weeds... Where you belong...
He makes a face at her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, I don't even know why I bother. I guess I'll just throw these away...
He mimes tossing them, but Paige stops him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey wait... I'll keep them. They're so sad-looking after all.
He hands them over, and she brings her face close, smiling into the bouquet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank goodness!
$ZOE snatches the beeping stopwatch from Nicole. She shuts it off and runs back to the S.E.T. side of the room.
`Beep! Beep! Beep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Beep! Beep! Beep![/b]

nodes.text: $ZOE looks mournfully at her stopwatch, then at the resolute glares on Maria and Nicole's faces.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll try to do it fast.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Pretty good, right?
Maria and Nicole just stare stonily at her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: From the top then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd I do?
When she rights herself, she sees Maria and Nicole scowl.
$ZOE jumps up and touches both hands to her toes, landing with a triumphant grin on her face!
$ZOE hesitates, unsure what to do. At last second, she cartwheels awkwardly!
She does a...
She takes one step too many!
Taking a deep breath, $ZOE gathers her strength...
$ZOE forgets how many times to step!
$ZOE brings her feet and pom-poms together in front of her and...
Nicole looks offended, but $ZOE presses on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... 'Till we weigh a ton'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Twin Branches cheerleaders aren't just out for fun...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We don't stop cheering...
Then she yells...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not right...
But $ZOE refocuses and yells...
$ZOE forgets how many times to clap and keeps going for several beats!
$ZOE worriedly looks over at Sam. Though she's still writing, Sam seems to be struggling to keep her eyes on the test booklet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If that's all...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wait, we're not just here to fill our social calendars.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Says you.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're talking to $ZOE because she wasn't at practice today, and she doesn't know the cheers.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So if she can't come to practice, maybe we can bring practice to her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's incredibly thoughtful, but I don't have time at the moment...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What are you doing exactly?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It looks a lot like you're just sitting around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Running the stopwatch for the S.E.T. test takers.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And how much time is left?
$ZOE glances down at her stopwatch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That's perfect! That's all the time you need to learn the first cheer.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! And we're not leaving you alone until you get it right!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The beach?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's sunny these days, so it'd be hot. There are boys at the beach, and we can barbecue and make s'mores while we're there.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sign me up! I like a good hunk of meat with my hunk of man.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad you approve.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll think of something amazing later. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Fine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Spas have saunas that are really warm!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I like spa days as much as the next girl, but come on, $ZOE, what about the boys? And the food?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They kind of have food that's good `for` you... If you count the cucumbers in the water, that is.

nodes.text: I'll think of something amazing later. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Fine.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ice skating?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. There are boys at the ice skating rink.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And the food `must` be good becuase you're always hungry after ice skating. And they have hot chocolate with marshmallows.
nodes.text_bbcode: And the food [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] be good becuase you're always hungry after ice skating. And they have hot chocolate with marshmallows.

nodes.text: Uh, no. I hate it. What part of that is `hot,` $ZOE? How can you look good when you have to wear more than one layer of clothing?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no. I hate it. What part of that is [color=#3b78e2][i]hot,[/i][/color] $ZOE? How can you look good when you have to wear more than one layer of clothing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll think of something amazing later. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Fine.

nodes.text: `That's` your big idea?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] your big idea?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it'd be good training for the summer...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it meets all your needs. You get hot, there are sometimes boys at boot camp, and, uh, I'm sure food will taste amazing afterwards?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That's a `terrible` idea. It's the end of our season. I don't want to do `more` work!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, I thought this was a party for `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I thought this was a party for [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll think of something amazing later. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Fine.
No sooner has she said the words when Maria and Nicole burst into the library!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, girls... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're here to cheer!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In the library?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yes. In the library. $ZOE, you weren't at practice this afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It seems like you've been missing a lot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have... Taylor assigned the graduation party budget to me, and I had to help a friend with something. But, I thought I sent Amanda to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She told us you were 'taking a raincoat'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Rain`check.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Rain[color=#3b78e2][i]check.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: We figured it out.

nodes.text: We got the message, $ZOE, but that's not the point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, and I'm really sorry... I don't mind practicing on Saturday to make up for missed time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The cheerleading team definitely deserves more of my attention... Zoe [SURPRISED]: You know, now that I think about it, there are some unallocated funds in the budget for cheerleading...

nodes.text: For reals?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, that's nice and all but--

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hold on! I want to hear what she has to say. I've been waiting for this moment ever since $ZOE got Social Chair! What awesome thing are you going to do with the money?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Something `hot?` Something that involves `boys?` Something with `good food?` All three?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Something [color=#3b78e2][i]hot?[/i][/color] Something that involves [color=#3b78e2][i]boys?[/i][/color] Something with [color=#3b78e2][i]good food?[/i][/color] All three?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, sure! I can host...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, $ZOE, having you for a cousin isn't half bad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks.
Over the next several minutes, students start to trickle into the library and find seats at the tables arranged in rows...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Long time, no see, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, like half an hour.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nice work on the setup. It looks so much like the real test day that it's giving me chills.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Good? I think.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go sit down, guys. It's two to a table.
Ben and Emily share a table and laugh over a joke. Kimi sits by herself behind them.
Then the rest of the test-takers arrive...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You all ready to do this? If anyone can turn the S.E.T. into a P.A.R.T.Y., then it's me!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Woo! S.E.T. party!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I bet your Uncle Mal didn't have to take the S.E.T.s to become a detective with the SFPD.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, first off, yes, he did. Second, taking the S.E.T.s is an important part of the high school experience.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Which I am so over?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just think of the S.E.T. as the last hurdle before we move away from Centerscore for good.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess... But seriously, where's an exploding helicopter when you need it?
$ZOE clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, everyone! Welcome to the practice S.E.T.! Let's get started.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I say 'go', turn to the first section. I'll let everyone know when their time is up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And go!
$ZOE starts the timer on her phone.
And for a couple minutes, all goes still.
Everyone works on their tests, heads bent, pencils moving on their papers.
The only sounds that can be heard in the library are the flutter of test pages and the scratching of old-fashioned pencils...
...And then the door bursts open and Erik walks in, carrying an extremely large duffel bag.
He throws it onto a library table with a 'thud' and starts taking out a bunch of pamphlets.
$ZOE rushes over to him, whispering frantically.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik, what are you doing here?
Erik perks up and blithely talks at a normal volume.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hi, $ZOE! I have a merit badge evaluation next week!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Merit badges? Aren't you a little old for the Eagle Scouts?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: An Eagle Scout once is an Eagle Scout always. You can earn merit badges right up until the end of high school!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I have quite a few to prove myself for: first aid, fire safety, wood carving, knife safety, animal domestication, animal safety... The list goes on!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if I'm going to get the badges, I need to practice. That's why I'm here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Got to give it that old college try! Er... Old high school try!
Erik peeks around to $ZOE's side of the library.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Boy, it sure is full in here! What are you guys doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Practicing for the S.E.T.s.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! I see!
He drops his voice to a conspiratorial whisper.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I won't bother you then!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're sure?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Abso-lala-lutely! I already earned my merit badge for 'Whisper Time'...
Erik lugs his giant bag to a far corner of the library and starts to set things up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a good thing Erik's so willing to compromise...
$ZOE starts to head over to her side of the room when she hears a loud, shrill alarm go off!
`Screeeeeeeeee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Screeeeeeeeee![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ah!
The alarm startles all the other test-takers.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's like a choir of howler monkeys and screech owls!
$ZOE looks around for the source of the noise.
`Screeeeeeeeee!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Screeeeeeeeee![/b]

nodes.text: $ZOE sees Erik is taking the battery in and out of a fire alarm he's studying. He looks up when he notices $ZOE staring.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... This is really loud, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry. Part of fire safety is explaining how a fire alarm works and how often you need to replace your batteries.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Turns out this one still works!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...But I can leave if you want...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I want you to pass your evaluations, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Why don't you try working on a different merit badge?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I suppose I could... But which one?
$ZOE remembers the list he'd brought up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He did say something about first aid or wood carving...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can work on...
$ZOE walks back towards her side of the room, passing Erik on her way over.
Erik is now grabbing a handful of dried twigs and leaves from his bag and examining each specimen before throwing them into a wastebasket just under the fire extinguisher.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've moved onto the next merit badge?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yep. Botany and plant identification.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds nice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And quiet!
While Sam and several others are working diligently, Ben has torn up pieces of his answer sheet to pass notes to Emily.
$ZOE sees that Ben's written out a list of fun date ideas, and she shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess for underclassmen, this really is a practice run more than anything else...
$ZOE's stopwatch beeps, signaling the end of the test section.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right. Next up is the writing section. Go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But can we not do it here?
They push her to the other side of the library. Nicole grabs the stopwatch out of $ZOE's hands.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'll watch this for you if you're worried.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So here's the cheer...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: First you `clap twice`...
nodes.text_bbcode: First you [color=#3b78e2][i]clap twice[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Then you yell, 'Twin Branches cheerleaders aren't just out for fun...'

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: 'We won't stop cheering `till we're number one!`'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'We won't stop cheering [color=#3b78e2][i]till we're number one![/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Then you take `three` steps to the left, pivot, and turn.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then you take [color=#3b78e2][i]three[/i][/color] steps to the left, pivot, and turn.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Then `toe-touch.` You got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then [color=#3b78e2][i]toe-touch.[/i][/color] You got it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Awesome! Now prove it!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And go!
$ZOE puts her hands together and...
They nod.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do I do again?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: That was awesome!
Score Up!
On her way, $ZOE notices that the mood of the library has changed for the worse...
She passes by Erik in his corner, humming a tune while placing kindling in a wastebasket. A thin stream of smoke rises from the basket.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Fire safety is the best... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { Make a fire to safely test... {
She passes by the nerds who are all standing up angrily, nearly pushing over their chairs!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That was a noob move, Brendan! And it was low too.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's the same move you pulled on me the last time we played!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah, Dex. No need to be such a second-level troll about it.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Say that again to my face!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, guys? My character is still stuck at the bottom of this ladder...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: It's `up` on the D-pad, Kimi!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#e23b3b][i]up[/i][/color] on the D-pad, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooohhh...
And right as she gets back to the test-takers, she finds Hector and Amanda giggling to themselves, while Ben is showing off a huge list of activities in his test booklet that Emily is smiling over.
Only Sam, Denni, and surprisingly, Colt are still hunched over their tests. $ZOE realizes on closer inspection that Colt has fallen asleep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, everyone who's still working can put their pencils down now. The last section is English, and it starts `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, everyone who's still working can put their pencils down now. The last section is English, and it starts [color=#3b78e2][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She has just clicked the start button on her stopwatch when a huge crash comes from the midst of the Robotics Club!
A table has flipped over between Dex and Kevin. The two nerds circle each other.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Kevin!
Dex lunges at Kevin, and the two boys topple over!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Prepare to be `Dexterminated!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Prepare to be [color=#e23b3b][i]Dexterminated![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Before $ZOE can intervene, she is distracted by Erik who's worriedly waving his arms. He points back towards his smoking wastebasket.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE! Not to alarm you, but I'm going to need your help. You see, there's a fi--
Whatever Erik was about to say is drowned out by the sudden blaring of music over the P.A. system!
The doors to the library burst open... And $ZOE's stomach clenches with dread.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What now?
You are now playing as Owen.
Miles and miles away from the troubles brewing in the library...
Owen and Paige tour the hallowed halls of Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now we're leaving the indoor spa facilities. Through that door, you can see our pool.
Paige indulges Owen as he peeks his head inside.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Whoa.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to say that about everything in sight. Geez, it's almost embarrassing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You guys have a huge, outdoor `gold-plated` swimming pool!
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys have a huge, outdoor [color=#e23b3b][i]gold-plated[/i][/color] swimming pool!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How else would you tan on both sides when you're swimming?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That... Is a good point...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aww... You're not entirely `un`cute when you're bewildered.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww... You're not entirely [color=#3b78e2][i]un[/i][/color]cute when you're bewildered.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't strain yourself on the compliment.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, you should feel lucky I even tried.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, I do.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But one question... Last time when I tried to break in, this place was like a shantytown dungeon. Now it's `so` nice I'm expecting butler unicorns at any moment...
nodes.text_bbcode: But one question... Last time when I tried to break in, this place was like a shantytown dungeon. Now it's [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] nice I'm expecting butler unicorns at any moment...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not that I'm not happy... But what happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought we went over this already. I'm the `Perfect` now.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought we went over this already. I'm the [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The Butterfly Detention Center still exists, and trust me, it's still totally `gross`... But now I get access to the whole school!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Butterfly Detention Center still exists, and trust me, it's still totally [color=#3b78e2][i]gross[/i][/color]... But now I get access to the whole school!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Plus, things have changed a bit since I took charge.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Took charge?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. There was this girl named Jessica who used to be the queen of the school... I got rid of her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She used to run the school because her parents were rich, and she's manipulative. But I beat her at her own game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yikes, I'd fear for my life if I were her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can imagine she's doing a ton of fearing in social isolation.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What kind of weird school is this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So where do you want to go next on the tour?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Honestly? I'd like to see a room without a gold-plated something or other...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, there is a room made out of chocolate where everything is edible...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're such a liar. There is not.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There is too! But since that has a gold-plated chocolate fountain `and` since you're being such a doofus, we're going to the gardens. Come on.
nodes.text_bbcode: There is too! But since that has a gold-plated chocolate fountain [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] since you're being such a doofus, we're going to the gardens. Come on.

nodes.text: She grabs his hand, and Owen lets her lead him into a pretty garden.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is it me, or is that bush shaped like a dolphin?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called a `topiary.` Basic Horticulture 101. Or do they not cover that in poor school?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's called a [color=#3b78e2][i]topiary.[/i][/color] Basic Horticulture 101. Or do they not cover that in poor school?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I didn't come here so that you could just insult me all evening.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, maybe just a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is the first kind of 'date' we've been on since Valentine's Day. I wonder if I should do something special.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Paige, close your eyes for a second.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Stop being so difficult for once, and just do it.

She covers her eyes with both hands while he looks around for something to give her. His gaze lands on a patch of several flowers. Roses grow high in thorny bushes, while daisies grow low near the weeds.
He grabs...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know it's not the gameplay experience you wanted, but I can get the Robotics Club a free lunch for your victory.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Deal. I'll take a free lunch any day.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then it's settled.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah. Free is delicious!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You set a low bar, Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But fine. As long as we get to pick the lunch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right.
$ZOE rushes over to where a fire extinguisher is encased in glass. She tries to open the case, but it's jammed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Arg!

options.label: Throw a book at the glass!

nodes.text: No sooner has she said the words when Maria and Nicole burst into the library!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, girls... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're here to cheer!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In the library?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yes. In the library. $ZOE, you weren't at practice this afternoon.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It seems like you've been missing a lot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have... Taylor assigned the graduation party budget to me, and I had to help a friend with something. But, I thought I sent Amanda to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She told us you were 'taking a raincoat'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Rain`check.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Rain[color=#3b78e2][i]check.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We figured it out.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We got the message, $ZOE, but that's not the point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, and I'm really sorry... I don't mind practicing on Saturday to make up for missed time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The cheerleading team definitely deserves more of my attention... Zoe [SURPRISED]: You know, now that I think about it, there are some unallocated funds in the budget for cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: For reals?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, that's nice and all but--

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hold on! I want to hear what she has to say. I've been waiting for this moment ever since $ZOE got Social Chair! What awesome thing are you going to do with the money?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Something `hot?` Something that involves `boys?` Something with `good food?` All three?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Something [color=#3b78e2][i]hot?[/i][/color] Something that involves [color=#3b78e2][i]boys?[/i][/color] Something with [color=#3b78e2][i]good food?[/i][/color] All three?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, sure! I can host...
$ZOE looks to Sam, who's rushing to finish up her problems.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope the drill wasn't `too` distracting...
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope the drill wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] distracting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Up next! Math! Please turn to the next section of your test. This is the math section, and you can use a calculator for this portion...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have another thirty minutes to finish this test. You may begin.
$ZOE looks to Sam who has finished her portion of the test and is ready to proceed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It seems like she's doing well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Up next! Math! Please turn to the next section of your test. This is the math section, and you can use a calculator for this portion...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have another thirty minutes to finish this test. You may begin.
A silence punctuated infrequently by the 'zzt' of Erik's hand drill reigns in the library.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can only hope Sam's ignoring that stupid drill!
`Zzzt!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Zzzt![/b]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess the noise isn't `so` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess the noise isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.text: And despite the interruptions, everyone is diligently working...
...That is until the Robotics Club bursts through the doors!
They talk loudly as they walk towards the computer cluster. They place enough cans of green soda and bags of cheesy puffs for a small army on the library tables near them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Who placed third in the Robotics competition?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh wait... That would be us!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We are the champions, my friends! We built the third smartest robot the convention had ever seen!
Dex affectionately slaps L.Y.L.E.'s monitor.

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: We accrued the third highest point value in an arbitrary competition biased by human processes!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Way to put a dampener on the victory party, L.Y.L.E.!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Butt. Butt. Butt.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess that's more like it?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Forget that! Let's just get things fired up.
Dex pushes a button, and a large projector screen meant for presentations opens from the ceiling and drops down.
Brendan fiddles with the projector's controls, and soon flashy robots fly across the screen accompanied by dramatic, metal rock music.
The members of the Robotics Club set up their laptops, and start maneuvering their robots into battle with some keystrokes from their keyboards.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Huzzah! Eat that, Kevin!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You only got that shot in because L.Y.L.E.'s an awful partner!

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Subject Kevin. Rate of 'awesomeness' is 0.006 percent.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So what? Brendan's my partner. It's not like he's much better.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hey Kevin, want a laser cannon to the face?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Only if you want my ejector arm to knock your sorry hunk of junk to the recycler!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Just try it!
$ZOE sees the test-takers turning around to see what's happening on the big projector. Even Sam is distracted whenever a metallic crunching echoes throughout the library.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't good...
$ZOE heads in their direction and soon finds herself flanked by Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi? Aren't you supposed to be taking the test?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I got bored. Ben and Emily are just talking to themselves and flirting with each other.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And besides, I figure I shouldn't study for the first test at all. Getting a lower score the first time will make my mother much happier when I improve the next time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's one way to look at it.
They walk up to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Girls at twelve o' clock!
Brendan pauses the game.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi, what's up?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Don't give me that, Kevin Delucca. What are you guys doing celebrating your third-place victory without me? Or Ben and Erik, for that matter? We're also on the team!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh, uh, when we asked Ben, he said he was doing something with Emily. And I figured you were hanging out with them too. And Erik... Well, Erik wanted to do his own thing...
He glances over at Erik who is happily studying his merit badges.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, huff.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: But hey, one of us could use a `less robotic` partner. You can totally join in.
nodes.text_bbcode: But hey, one of us could use a [color=#e23b3b][i]less robotic[/i][/color] partner. You can totally join in.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh yeah? I've never played, but it seems like fun.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Of course. Let's just switch some things up... You're going to be partnered with the best teacher around...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: How do you know you're the best?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I don't. Dex is.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooooh, Dex. Of course. `Sure.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooooh, Dex. Of course. [color=#3b78e2][i]Sure.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I don't want her on my team.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Just show her the controls! She's a quick-learner... I'm sure she'll be blasting me in no time!
They start to play when they realize $ZOE is still standing in front of the screen.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You want in too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. Uh, I hate to cut in, but I'm conducting an S.E.T. practice session, and it'd be better if the room was a little quieter. Is there anywhere else you can have your party?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, I'm sure we can figure something out...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No, we can't! We've waited an entire week for this to happen! And where do you think we're going to have this LAN party?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Brendan's parents are having their own thing tonight, my house isn't big enough, and as for Kevin's place...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I refuse to play on that useless dinosaur he calls a router.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE. This is the only place I know that has a projector big enough for all of us to play our game comfortably.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to ruin your celebration, but maybe we can compromise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you can...
Once again silence reigns through the library, and $ZOE is relieved.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope Sam can ace this...

The next afternoon, armed with a vacuum and a mop, $ZOE surveys the mess in the library with a heavy sigh.
Oh man, this is going to take forever to clean up.
$ZOE steps onto the waterlogged carpet, her shoes splooshing with every step.
Broken pencils, torn up test booklets, and smashed snack bars lie in puddles on the soggy floor, scattered.
Half the tables have cheese puffs floating in green soda syrup on them. The other half have scuff marks from the shoes of dancing students.
$ZOE can see smoke stains on the wall in the back, and several piles of books have fallen off the shelves.
$ZOE picks up a trash can and starts putting stuff into it.
It's going to take an awful long time to get that done if you're picking things up one at a time.
Sam, Owen, Ben, Emily, and Kimi are standing there, holding cleaning supplies.
Hey there, cuz. What's up? Besides about twenty sprinklers?
What are you guys doing here?
Well, we didn't want you to clean up everything by yourself. It's not your fault everything went crazy.
Plus, you organized the practice test to `help` us.
So we're here to return the favor!
Awww, thanks, guys! But... Owen, you didn't even take the test.
Yeah... Turns out I'm just an awesome friend.
Well, I'm not going to turn you guys down...
And together, $ZOE and her friends work until the library is all clean.
Thank you so much for helping me out! You guys are the best!
Is that everything? Can we go now?
Yep! I just need to take the trash out. I'll meet you at my car, okay?
$ZOE walks to the dumpster with two very full trash bags. She struggles with the lid of the dumpster when it's suddenly opened for her by none other than school grifter, Wes.
$ZOE, you've finally learned. I'm so proud.
$ZOE holds the dumpster lid up on her own and swings the two bags inside. She closes it, dusting her hands off.
What do you want, Wes? I didn't think grunt work was your forte.
I wasn't talking about helping you take out the garbage. I was talking about helping you clean up the dark mark you've put on your permanent record.
Can you just stop dancing around what you're talking about for once?
For one `delightful` favor, I can expunge whatever McCormick put onto your record before Kingston starts sniffing it out on their own.
You want to go to Kingston, don't you? I hear they don't like troublemakers who blow up the library.
Why should I get your help? I can always explain things when I interview.
Sometimes colleges don't listen. With the competition becoming fiercer and fiercer, having something like that around your neck's going to weigh against you.
And I can definitely think of at least one person who'd be disappointed if you didn't make it into Kingston this year...
So what do you say? A simple favor for me helping you get into the college of your dreams?
What was $ZOE's answer? And what exactly is Wes up to? Find out soon on Surviving High School!
